requirementSummary: The ticket defines UI behavior and data handling for configuring Air‑Cooled (AC) and Evaporative‑Cooled (EC) condensers. Selecting a condenser type shows the corresponding input fields, records entered parameters, provides default values and specific option lists (e.g., condenser passes 2‑41, AutoOdd/AutoEven; roof type dark/light with/without parapet), and ultimately outputs a complete condenser and circuit‑level configuration ready for ECS calculation.
businessRules: When the user selects Condenser Type "AC" or "EC", the corresponding input fields shall be displayed.
Design Ambient input shall accept values in °F or °C and default to 95°F if not entered; the value is echoed in output 3.7.
ASHRAE Summer Design input shall accept numeric values in °F or °C with no default.
Default Condenser checkbox shall be presented to allow the user to select condenser selection mode.
High Amb. / Altit. Cond. checkbox shall be presented to allow the user to select condenser selection mode.
Condenser Tube Material dropdown shall default to "Copper".
Condenser Fin Material dropdown shall default to "Aluminum".
Condenser Tube Size dropdown shall default to "3/8, 3/8 w/ 1\" spacing".
Condenser Fin Type dropdown shall default to "Corrugated".
Bank ID# shall be provided by the system (ID source).
Copies of this Bank shall be a numeric input with no specified range.
EC Model shall be a dropdown populated from the catalog; options are not enumerated in the ticket.
Wet Bulb Temperature shall accept numeric values in °F or °C with no default.
When processed, the system shall output condenser and circuit‑level configuration ready for ECS calculation.
When the user configures an AC condenser and enters ambient design conditions and coil geometry, the system shall record the AC condenser parameters.
When the user configures an EC condenser and enters the EC model and wet bulb temperature, the system shall record the EC condenser parameters.
When the user configures an AC condenser and selects Condenser Passes, the system shall display options: AutoOdd, AutoEven, and every integer from 2 through 41 inclusive (increment of 1).
When the user configures an AC condenser and selects Roof Type, the system shall display dark and light roof type options, each with variants "with parapet/shrouding" and "without parapet/shrouding".
developerConsiderations: Implement conditional UI rendering to show AC‑specific fields when Condenser Type = AC and EC‑specific fields when Condenser Type = EC.

Provide default values for Design Ambient (95°F), Condenser Tube Material (Copper), Condenser Fin Material (Aluminum), Condenser Tube Size (3/8, 3/8 w/ 1" spacing), and Condenser Fin Type (Corrugated).
Support numeric input components for Design Ambient, ASHRAE Summer Design, Wet Bulb Temperature, and Copies of this Bank.
Render dropdown lists for Condenser Passes with the exact set: AutoOdd, AutoEven, and integers 2‑41 step 1.
Render Roof Type dropdown with four explicit options: dark‑with parapet, dark‑without parapet, light‑with parapet, light‑without parapet.
Capture and persist entered AC condenser parameters and EC condenser parameters as defined by the acceptance criteria.
Generate a consolidated output object containing both condenser‑level and circuit‑level configuration data suitable for downstream ECS calculation.
ambiguities: What are the valid numeric ranges or validation rules for ASHRAE Summer Design, Wet Bulb Temperature, and Copies of this Bank?
